2026-11-10 slice: nine on-air setup tiles (pattern, minutes, warm-up, ambient, bell tone, interval, end bell) moved to choiceTileClasses and seven Journey v2 controls (drip, target and settings tiles, difficulty and format pills, pillar pill, official flag) to chipClasses or choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 162 to 146. Idle tiles gain the kit's bg-surface and selected pills the kit's solid-ink chip, by design. About 146 sites remain, mostly admin (28) and bespoke controls whose bg-primary-bg tint matches the lexical counter; the row stays open.

2026-11-10 slice 3: the Space branding form's seven selectable tiles (logo backdrop, hero height, button orientation, scrim, look, theme, soon-state theme) moved to choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 146 to 139. Active tiles are disabled, so each keeps disabled:opacity-100 over the kit's disabled dimming. About 139 sites remain.

2026-11-11 slice 4: practice builder Focus, Effort and timer-kind tiles and the join induction's option tiles (two feature tiles and one answer tile) moved to choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 139 to 133. About 133 sites remain; the dense editor inspector controls (segmented bars, the 28x16 switch) are left on purpose because the kit Switch and chip change their size and fill.

2026-11-11 slice 5: event form attendance-mode and price-mode tiles moved to choiceTileClasses; the Library create studio type pill and the guest seat form option pill moved to chipClasses; raw-button-bg 133 to 129. The create studio's Quick/Rich engine switch is a segmented pair and stays. About 129 sites remain.

2026-11-11 slice 6: walkthrough editor icon tiles to choiceTileClasses; demo studio preset and channel pills and the dispatch composer type pills to chipClasses; raw-button-bg 129 to 124. About 124 sites remain.

2026-11-16 slice 7 (admin): raw-button-bg 124 to 94. Row-action icon clusters (Channels, Circles, Crew tasks, Dispatches, Hubs, Nexuses: edit, hide, archive, publish, delete) moved to the kit IconButton with tones. Two-way and few-way switches (contact sort, Library engine Quick/Rich, Loom style kind, segment all/any, walkthrough layout, email preview width, Theme Studio light/dark) moved to SegmentedControl, which also gives the three that had no aria-pressed an announced state. Admin-route pills (practice flag filters, sequence personas, listing amenities, CRM task filter) moved to chipClasses. Selectable tiles and option rows (import vertical, email canvas device, menu surface tabs, channel and event header height, personal skin, page layout scope and template, page status, Space theme cards) moved to choiceTileClasses. The option rows that open in the page-settings sheet use choiceTileClasses, not chipClasses, on purpose: on a phone that sheet is portaled to the body outside the members kit scope, where the kit .chip has no styles. Their selected look is now the brand outline and wash, not a solid fill. Left in admin on purpose (6): the 14px bulk switch in the practices table header (the kit Switch is larger than the column), the automations Enabled/Disabled status pill (a success-toned status toggle; the hit is its hover wash), the member economy currency pair (it sits beside the Grant/Revoke pair whose green and red fills the kit segment cannot carry, so both stay matched), the two QR preset pills and the filter-bar applied-filter pill (held back to keep this PR under 30 files; both are chipClasses candidates). About 94 sites remain, none of the admin ones a plain action; the row stays open for the full-area rendered review.

2026-11-16 slice 8 (events, spaces, settings, studio): raw-button-bg 94 to 73. The three admin leftovers (two QR preset pill rows, the filter-bar applied-filter pill) moved to chipClasses. Yes/no answers in the RSVP questions and the guest seat form moved to SegmentedControl (the seat form keeps its saving lock through a disabled fieldset). Ticket tier rows, rate options and the membership fold, Space booking time slots, the Space form Default color option, CRM autonomy tiles, Space mode focus tiles, the profile header overlay options and the practice builder Movement mode tiles moved to choiceTileClasses. Space Loom tag facets, the Spaces directory Sort trigger, and the Studio Spark mood, pin and pillar pills moved to chipClasses. The Space Airwaves Recordings/Shows switch moved to SegmentedControl and the text-notification category toggles to the kit Switch, matching the mutes form beside them. Every family was rendered before and after at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 in light and at 390 and 1440 in dark. Tried, rendered and reverted because the kit size made a tight member row worse: the feed composer formatting row and emoji trigger and the event activity composer icons and Dispatch toggle (the kit icon control is 44px in the members kit and both rows overflow a 390 phone), the feed reply send button (it grows past its field and takes the action gradient under every post), the Space reviews sort (the segmented box clips its last option at 390), the Space module manager Activate toggle (the 40px chip squeezes the row text), and the calendar month jump grid (twelve bordered tiles replace a clean date grid and its shown-month pill). Left on purpose: reaction and boop pills (dense counters under every post), mention and location suggestion rows (combobox options), the calendar day dots and repeats strip, the settings Mode rows (divided list rows in one card), the Space events popup row, the practice icon tile, the induction reel dots, plus the standing list (entity-blocks inspector controls, global-error, the Airwaves play button, circle-location-search, Journey v2 editor controls, probe-pinned buttons). About 73 sites remain. The composer and reply rows need a compact kit icon size before they can move; the row stays open for the full-area rendered review.

2026-11-16 slice 9 (editors and builders, plus a kit size): raw-button-bg 73 to 56. The kit SegmentedControl gains a compact xs size: a quiet track with 24px segments, spelled in Tailwind token classes so it also styles in a sheet or dialog portaled outside the members kit, with no tap-target floor because it is dense editor chrome. It is additive: a unit test pins that sm and md render the classes they rendered before, and a segment can now carry its own accessible name and tooltip for icon-only options. Moved onto it: the block inspector Segmented in both bar and wrap mode (every inspector control that composes it), the profile page builder and Space canvas row layout pickers, the elements gallery header sort, the Journey settings visibility choice (which now announces its pressed state), and the induction sequence editor preview beat bar. Moved to the standard SegmentedControl: the sequence editor completion destination pair and the member viewer sort row. Moved to choiceTileClasses: Circle builder how-it-meets tiles, price quick-pick amounts, the new room visibility tiles, new task effort tiers, the CRM import merge rule and the card face tap mode. Circle builder main-focus pills moved to chipClasses. Every family was rendered before and after at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 in light and at 390 and 1440 in dark, inside the members kit and outside any kit. literal-radius 603 to 595 and raw-px-arbitrary 54 to 50 fell with the same edits and were re-frozen downward. About 56 sites remain. Still waiting on a kit size: the inspector Toggle and the practices table bulk switch (the kit Switch is 46 by 28 and has no compact size), and the feed and event composer rows and reply send button (the kit icon control is 44px in the members kit). Not yet tried: the Journey v2 editor quiet text actions, which could take the kit ghost Button at xs (32px) once rendered in their rows. Left on purpose as before: reaction and boop pills, combobox and listbox option rows, calendar day dots and the repeats strip, settings Mode rows, the inspector icon picker cells and entity filter rows, global-error, the Airwaves play button, probe-pinned buttons. The row stays open for the full-area rendered review.
